Please can you explain why you are blatently using variable pricing and whether you will honour the original basket price. Many thanks and kind regards, Kay Richardson

I am usually good at shade matching online but it is almost impossible with your online shade selection format as there is no picture with all the shades next to each other. The easiest method for online shade matching is when every shade is swatched on at least 3 different arms of varying shades so that you can judge the depth and undertone against multiple factors. With yours, I can only see small groups of shades at a time, and there is no way to compare one group with another group. The models' faces are also confusing because for some reason on my computer, there is very little shade difference between many of them. I'm not suggesting I return the shade (even though it is a bit dark). I just thought it might help to receive this feedback to hopefully make it easier next time. Kind regards, Tania

customer_comment_samples: Hello Jones Road Beauty Customer Service, I recently received my order (#6281992), which included three Lip Tints in the shades Rose, Sangria, and Dahlia. I tried Rose and Sangria twice each, and while I absolutely love the texture and feel of the product, I found that the color payoff was much more sheer than it appeared online. Because of this, the shades did not work for me as I had hoped. I have not tried the Dahlia shade since my experience with the other two colors led me to believe it would likely be too sheer for my preference as well. I would like to request a return of all three items. In the future, I may purchase the clear/no-color version, as I do enjoy the formula itself. Please let me know the next steps for processing the return and what is the shipping address for returns. Thank you for your assistance. Kind regards, Negin Ghaedi
